title: Ramayana: Part One crosses Rs 1,000 crore worldwide in eight days, tracker estimates
dek: Nitesh Tiwari's film is the 11th Indian release to pass the mark, according to a box-office tracker. The makers have not published figures.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Ramayana: Part One has crossed Rs 1,000 crore in gross worldwide box-office takings, according to estimates by one box-office tracker, which put its total at about Rs 1,033.55 crore by the end of Thursday, its eighth day in cinemas. That makes it the 11th Indian film to pass the mark, by the same tracker's count. The makers have not published official figures, and trackers' estimates differ.

The tracker put the film's India net collection at about Rs 564.6 crore after eight days, including about Rs 53.5 crore on Thursday.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film opened on 5 November and had its biggest day on 9 November, during the Diwali holidays, with about Rs 107.5 crore net in India, according to the tracker. The Hindi version accounts for most of its earnings.

The film is the first of two parts. Its second weekend, from 13 to 15 November, will show how well it holds up after the holiday period.
